entities.summary: Geldolph Adriaan "Dolf" Kessler was a Dutch footballer and industrialist. Kessler – along with brother Boeli and cousins Tonny and Dé – played club football for amateur side HVV Den Haag. Kessler also won three caps for the Netherlands national side between 1905 and 1906.
